advisoryFindings.title: Enabled count bound is only indirectly covered
advisoryFindings.improvement: Add a direct assertion for the enabled-package count bound if the CLI exposes it in progress/result metadata, or document that the disabled-package exclusion assertion in R5 is the intended proxy.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The current tests cover the high-risk behavioral surface for enabled-only bulk updates and disabled exclusion, so implementation is not blocked; the remaining gap is precision around one phrase of R1.
